description: This file is a shell script used for setting up and managing Docker-based deployment of the OpenClaw application, including configuration management, Docker image building/pulling, sandbox setup, environment variable configuration, and startup sequencing.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks for the availability of a command and exits if not found.

methods.name: run_docker_build
methods.description: Builds a Docker image with BuildKit enabled.

methods.name: is_truthy_value
methods.description: Interprets a string as a boolean true value.

methods.name: read_config_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from the JSON config file using Python or Node if available.

methods.name: read_env_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from environment variable file.

methods.name: ensure_control_ui_allowed_origins
methods.description: Ensures that the control UI allowed origins are set appropriately.

methods.name: sync_gateway_mode_and_bind
methods.description: Sets the gateway mode to local and binds the gateway.

methods.name: run_prestart_gateway
methods.description: Runs a Docker container for pre-start operations related to the gateway.

methods.name: run_prestart_cli
methods.description: Executes a CLI command inside the openclaw-gateway container.

methods.name: run_runtime_cli
methods.description: Runs runtime CLI commands inside the Docker environment with specified scope and dependencies mode.

methods.name: contains_disallowed_chars
methods.description: Checks if a value contains disallowed control characters.

methods.name: is_valid_timezone
methods.description: Validates if a timezone string exists in the system timezone directory.

methods.name: validate_mount_path_value
methods.description: Validates mount path for disallowed characters and whitespace.

methods.name: validate_named_volume
methods.description: Validates a named volume string against allowed pattern.

methods.name: validate_mount_spec
methods.description: Validates the format of a mount specification string.

methods.name: write_extra_compose
methods.description: Generates an extra Docker Compose YAML overlay including specified mounts and volumes.
